Enables debug logging for interaction workers when dev mode is active.
LanguageData.EnhancedBeliefs.CertaintyDriftRate.Tip: How fast a pawn's certainty moves toward its target each day. Higher = faith reacts faster to circumstances.
LanguageData.EnhancedBeliefs.DifficultyOffset.Tip: Flat shift applied to every pawn's target certainty. Positive makes faith stickier; negative makes converts easier to peel away.
LanguageData.EnhancedBeliefs.RelationalMaxRange.Tip: The most that a pawn's opinion of their co-religionists can raise or lower their target certainty.
LanguageData.EnhancedBeliefs.PracticeMaxRange.Tip: The most that recent precept moods (rituals, veneration, taboos) can raise or lower their target certainty.
LanguageData.EnhancedBeliefs.ConversionPace.Tip: How quickly pawns abandon a poorly-fitting faith on their own, relative to default. Higher = spontaneous conversions happen faster. Only affects passive drift; debates and conversion attempts are unaffected.
LanguageData.EnhancedBeliefs.CrisisThreshold.Tip: When a pawn's certainty falls below this, they may have a crisis-of-faith breakdown instead of converting. They also won't switch to a faith they like less than this.
LanguageData.EnhancedBeliefs.PreceptOppositionScale.T: How strongly a pawn opposes the stance at the opposite extreme of an issue, as a fraction of their conviction. Opinion falls from full agreement at their own stance to this much opposition at the far end. 0 = they merely grow indifferent to opposing stances; 100% = full opposition (and harder to convert). Higher = pawns are pickier about differing beliefs.
